title: Design CI publishing for generated host artifacts
description: Verify and implement a GitHub Actions publishing flow for generated Codex, Claude, and Gemini host packages. Strategy to evaluate: keep generated host outputs gitignored in main, build them in CI with python3 scripts/package.py build --target all, validate with package checks and host validators, then publish installable artifacts via the right channel: release assets, a generated publishing branch, or marketplace-compatible repo layout. Confirm Claude marketplace expectations, Gemini extension install behavior, and Codex plugin install behavior before implementation.

title: Revisit all bundled personas and list improvements
description: Before public publishing, review every bundled persona pack for fidelity, repetition risk, stale phrasing, source grounding, and missing evaluation cases. Produce a concrete improvement list by persona before making broad edits.

title: Document persona injection and context behavior
description: Create a transparent document explaining how a persona gets injected, what context/system-instruction layers it affects, what it cannot override, and how users should reason about session-wide versus one-off persona activation.

title: Research better persona injection mechanisms
description: Review how Personify currently injects personas into agent context and research whether command, skill, plugin, or context-layer mechanics can make the behavior more reliable across Codex, Claude, and Gemini.
